protected.description: If true, image will not be deletable.

os_hidden.description: If true, image will not appear in default image list response.

os_hash_value.description: Hexdigest of the image contents using the algorithm specified by the os_hash_algo

size.description: Size of image file in bytes

virtual_size.description: Virtual size of image in bytes

created_at.description: Date and time of image registration

updated_at.description: Date and time of the last image modification

tags.description: List of strings related to the image

direct_url.description: URL to access the image file kept in external store

min_ram.description: Amount of ram (in MB) required to boot image.

min_disk.description: Amount of disk space (in GB) required to boot image.

stores.description: Store in which image data resides.  Only present when the operator has enabled multiple stores.  May be a comma-separated list of store identifiers.

validation_data.description: Values to be used to populate the corresponding image properties. If the image status is not 'queued', values must exactly match those already contained in the image properties.

locations.description: A set of URLs to access the image file kept in external store

kernel_id.description: ID of image stored in Glance that should be used as the kernel when booting an AMI-style image.

ramdisk_id.description: ID of image stored in Glance that should be used as the ramdisk when booting an AMI-style image.

instance_uuid.description: Metadata which can be used to record which instance this image is associated with. (Informational only, does not create an instance snapshot.)

architecture.description: Operating system architecture as specified in https://docs.openstack.org/python-glanceclient/latest/cli/property-keys.html

os_distro.description: Common name of operating system distribution as specified in https://docs.openstack.org/python-glanceclient/latest/cli/property-keys.html

os_version.description: Operating system version as specified by the distributor.

description.description: A human-readable string describing this image.

cinder_encryption_key_id.description: Identifier in the OpenStack Key Management Service for the encryption key for the Block Storage Service to use when mounting a volume created from this image

cinder_encryption_key_deletion_policy.description: States the condition under which the Image Service will delete the object associated with the 'cinder_encryption_key_id' image property.  If this property is missing, the Image Service will take no action
